author: coder-sonnet
message: Fixed FIX-001 (Execute button always disabled). File touched: tools/roadmap-dashboard/index.html only. Root cause confirmed: el() helper (line 205-215) called node.setAttribute(k, v) for every attribute key including null/undefined/false values; because 'disabled' is a boolean HTML attribute, setting it to the string 'null' still disabled the button. Fix: added a guard 'else if (v === null || v === undefined || v === false) continue;' before the generic setAttribute branch, so falsy attribute values are now skipped entirely (one line added, no other logic touched, no refactor). Audit of the rest of index.html: grepped every el(...) call site for attrs that could rely on the old always-set behavior; only one such site found -- the Execute button's disabled key (card renderer: disabled: (!canExecute || ticket.hasActiveRun) ? 'true' : null); no checked/readonly/required or other boolean attrs exist elsewhere in the file; value: '' usages (codex model-select placeholder, comment author input default) are unaffected since empty string is not null/undefined/false and was already being set correctly. Verification: did not restart the running server at 127.0.0.1:4570 (index.html is served per request, per instructions); curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4570/ shows the patched line 'v === null || v === undefined || v === false' present in the served markup; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4570/api/tickets confirms INF-001 rawState=pending, hasActiveRun=false (disabled expression evaluates to null -> attribute now omitted -> button enabled) and GOV-001 rawState=completed (disabled expression evaluates to 'true' -> attribute still set -> button stays disabled/not-allowed cursor via existing button:disabled CSS rule, untouched); inline <script> block extracted and passed through new Function(script) for a syntax check, passed with no errors. roadmap.md and server.mjs were not modified. roadmap-status.md updated with a matching completed ledger entry.

author: codex
message: Verified the existing FIX-001 patch in tools/roadmap-dashboard/index.html: el() skips null, undefined, and false attributes, so eligible Execute buttons can render enabled while completed/active tickets still render disabled. No out-of-scope files were changed in this pass.
